name: lesson
description: Learn API design and debugging through focused, code-centered improvements and self-contained lessons.

interface.shortDescription: Learn from code, improve it, and keep the lessons
interface.longDescription: Start with system context, focus on one bug or API design issue, compare options, implement and validate, then revisit the whole. Write self-contained Markdown lessons for users and future agents.
defaultPrompt: Use $lesson to find one design issue in this API with me, explain the tradeoffs, and improve it.
Use $lesson to explain this bug's cause, fix, and validation in a self-contained code walkthrough.
